shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat/upright stone face
curved, rounded forms in raised relief
justification: A shows an abstract, highly schematic composition of overlapping rounded/oval bosses and curving ridges with no legible figure, while B shows a clearly articulated winged anthropomorphic figure in profile with a bearded head, detailed feathered wing and outstretched arms beside a stylized plant. Beyond both being low-relief carving with some curvilinear forms, there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement, and the modelling conventions (blob-like mass versus fine linear detailing of hair, feathers and drapery) are quite different.
